data.one_liner: Native Dart implementation of machine learning algorithms and performance evaluation tools.
data.what_it_does: Provides native Dart implementations of popular machine learning algorithms including linear regression, logistic regression, decision trees, k-nearest neighbors, and clustering searchers. It supports cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning for Dart VM, Flutter, and web applications via WebAssembly.
use_when: You want to run machine learning models natively in Dart without relying on external native bindings.
You are working on data science projects or lightweight predictive features in Flutter and web apps.
avoid_when: You need complex deep learning architectures like neural networks or large language models.
Your dataset contains non-numeric types like strings or nulls without pre-processing them first.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation works across mobile, desktop, and web via WebAssembly.
Comprehensive collection of regression, classification, and retrieval algorithms.
Built-in cross-validation and performance metric tools.
weaknesses: Does not support strings, booleans, or nulls natively; data must be preprocessed into numbers.
Limited to classical machine learning algorithms rather than deep learning.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml along with ml_dataframe and ml_preprocessing for data handling.

alternatives.name: tflite_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need to run TensorFlow Lite models on mobile devices instead of pure Dart classical algorithms.
